facts.meaning: Each file has19 complete map/version records,52 ordered method declarations and220 ordered slots. Map5 alone hasv0 andv1. Each method's weights sum100; every slot has positive weight and inclusive level bounds, missing maximum means minimum. All19 omitted probability fields are15 rod and4 Headbutt declarations, whose EncounterType default is0. The other33 method declarations carry explicit probabilities. Preserve every record/method/slot literal and order in the packet, rather than only a Species projection.
facts.control: Gen5 andGen6 are byte-identical; default,Gen7 andGen8 are byte-identical but were each read. The only six semantic changes between groups are Map75 Land GEODUDE/RATTATA/DIGLETT/MEOWTH/SANDSHREW/VULPIX to corresponding _1 forms; CUBONE andPIKACHU unchanged. Map75 weights and levels unchanged.
facts.failure_prefix: These are static author fixtures, not evidence that all Species references are registered or a native compile succeeded. No author-file mutation or activation occurred.

facts.meaning: Compiler clears registry before all paths; header map/version uses decimal prefix to_i and omitted version0; Symbol id is map_version. Slots require positive weight/min/max, missing maximum=min, maximum level and min<=max guards. It merges only equal Species AND equal min AND equal max, then sorts weight descending and Species text ascending; there is no additional stable level/order tie promise. A repeated type clears that type's slots while omitted/empty probability retains prior probability or type default. Explicit probability uses to_i rather than slot positivity validation.
facts.control: Same Species at different level ranges remains separate; exact duplicates may merge. Zero step chance prevents walking trigger but does not by itself block direct candidate selection.
facts.failure_prefix: Previous section is merged/registered before duplicate next-header check. Errors preserve earlier in-memory registration and may precede final Encounter.save. A repeated type may already discard old slots. Final save is after all paths; no rollback or durable atomicity inferred.
facts.open: Full native get_csv_record/Enum/Marshal and actual written compiled file are not execution-validated; source definitions were personally read.

facts.meaning: Direct get selects exact Symbol-key map/version else map0; exists tests exact only. setup resets step_count and maps, copies step probabilities and Marshal-deep-copies type tables, but preserves chance_accumulator. reset_step_count resets both counters. Positive-version enumeration additionally checks Array key against ordinary Symbol registry, so v0 can accompanyv1. Dex Area uses that iterator, normalizes slot Species to base, then requires metadata/noHideFlag/matching region/occupied shape/visible Point before contributing union points.
facts.control: Map5 get(5,1) selects onlyv1 while iterator1 yieldsv0 thenv1; iterator0 yieldsv0 once. STARLY exists inv0 PokeRadar but notv1. No unconditional map point follows.
facts.failure_prefix: setup clears/reset fields before lookup/copy; copy failures can leave prefix. Read-only iterator has no cancellation/write. UI metadata/visibility gates can prevent contribution.

facts.meaning: MORE_ABILITIES flag read at trigger145 only changes INFILTRATOR half-chance/double-grace branch. Cleansing held items take precedence over all lead abilities. Earlier guards reject invalid/missing type, disabled/noPlayer/debugCtrl, absent/zero step chance or empty table; shaking Radar bypasses grace/chance only after these guards. Step path adds accumulator/200 and bicycle0.8; map lower-rate precedes higher-rate. Grace and final random checks are separate.
facts.control: Flag false leaves Infiltrator without that modifier; Stench/WhiteSmoke/QuickFeet and other listed branches have their own conditions. Flag true is not a universal ability success guarantee.
facts.failure_prefix: Grace increments step_count before its possible false return. Final miss adds base chance only on step path and resets accumulator if Repel active; early grace false skips that later accumulation. Errors can preserve prior step mutation.
facts.open: Host random sequence/distribution and all actual terrain/weather/ability objects are unobserved; formula is conditional static source behavior.

facts.meaning: REPEL_COUNTS_FAINTED true chooses first nonnil nonEgg, including fainted; false chooses first nonnil nonEgg nonfainted. Neither means raw party[0]. With active Repel, candidate level strictly below selected lead clears accumulator and rejects. Nil candidate rejects; Radar accepts before Repel. Afterwards Intimidate/KeenEye use first nonEgg and <=leadlevel-5 with rand100<50.
facts.control: Equal level passes Repel test; absent eligible lead skips its test. First-fainted lead affects true/false setting differently.
facts.failure_prefix: Repel rejection writes accumulator0 before false. Later ability rejection does not apply that write. No UI cancellation branch in this predicate.
facts.open: Whole Trainer source is not claimed; only complete necessary methods. Actual player/party/runtime probability remains conditional.

facts.meaning: MORE_ABILITIES gates FlashFire/FIRE, Harvest/GRASS, LightningRod/ELECTRIC and StormDrain/WATER preference. Each additionally requires registered favored Type and rand100<50. MagnetPull/STEEL and Static/ELECTRIC use their own equivalent checks without this setting. Successful preference builds a slot subset by Species.types; if empty it retains original table. Slot weights are not normalized individually; weighted draw uses sum of retained weights.
facts.control: Flag false suppresses only the four gated preferences; it does not suppress ordinary Static/MagnetPull. Favored type absent from slots preserves full table. Slot Species lookups must resolve.
facts.failure_prefix: Filtering may fail on a later Species lookup without choosing. Without a nonempty filtered copy, weight-descending sort! mutates cached table order before later random/level operations; this is current-map snapshot state, not file save.
facts.open: Full Species literal types for every referenced form and host RNG are not granted. Valid native table/predicate inputs remain prerequisites.

facts.meaning: Current-map chooser sorts descending weights, takes maximum among chance_rolls random offsets, subtracts weights in order, then chooses inclusive level range. Hustle/Pressure/VitalSpirit can replace level with max on rand100<50. Map lower-level flute flag takes precedence and subtractsrand1..4 bounded1; else higher-level addsrand1..4 bounded GrowthRate.max. These consume actual flags written by item flute callbacks. The separate for-map chooser uses direct get/currentversion, original registered table order and one weighted draw; no lead preference, Hustle or flute adjustment occurs there.
facts.control: Repeated rolls favor later/lower-weight slots after sorting; a normal chance_rolls1 is ordinary one draw. No extra tie-order guarantee is inferred. for-map path is not a walking trigger and does not consult step probability.
facts.failure_prefix: sort! precedes draw; choice/level/lead/form errors leave prior snapshot ordering. Neither method saves persistent files. Nil/empty table returnsnil before later steps.
facts.open: Range and offset semantics are conditional on existing WP06 legal native bounds; no executed uniform-distribution or real encounter guarantee. Invalid plugin tables/nonpositive totals are not normalized.

facts.meaning: MORE_ABILITIES affects only SuperLuck held-item chances60/20/5 instead of ordinary50/5/1; CompoundEyes receives60/20/5 independently. One rand100 determines tier thresholds. If all three item arrays compare equal, common-array sample is assigned regardless of tier roll; otherwise common/uncommon/rare thresholds are cumulative and remaining outcome leaves constructor item state. Pokemon construction and held-item assignment precede shiny/Pokerus/gender/nature/form/hook.
facts.control: Flag false leaves SuperLuck at ordinary chances. Equal arrays still follow common-array assignment. Empty sample can yieldnil; this is not proof of an awarded item.
facts.failure_prefix: Constructor, held-item access/sample and item setter can fail before shiny generation. Earlier object changes are not rolled back; no persistent save is performed here.
facts.open: Species wild-item literal arrays and all item reference lookup outcomes remain conditional; constructor native execution and all callbacks not run.

facts.meaning: ShinyCharm adds2 retries independently. HIGHER_SHINY flag enables battled_count bins0..49:[0,0],50..99:[1,15],100..199:[2,20],200..299:[3,25],300..499:[4,30],else:[5,30]. Extra retries are added only when positive threshold and rand1000<threshold: thresholds15/20/25/30 mean1.5/2/2.5/3 percent under uniform-native premise, not15/20/25/30 percent. Each retry first stops if current shiny?, otherwise resets cached shiny to nil and writes new32-bit PID from two16-bit draws.
facts.control: Flag false skips battled-count lookup/draw but preserves Charm retries. No retries means no retry-loop shiny query. Last newly written PID can remain unqueried until a later consumer.
facts.failure_prefix: Held item already assigned before retry logic; battled-count/lookup/random failures preserve earlier object state. Loop mutation is incremental and not a transaction.
facts.open: Actual default corpus battled counters and native distribution are unobserved. Source arithmetic does not prove a particular emitted shiny individual.

It assigns lead.nature, subject to setter prerequisites. Then optional getForm callback forces form_simple, creation event fires, and object returns.

facts.meaning: Active request writes temp.encounter_type before choice, fires on_wild_species_chosen even fornil, returnsfalse if no first/second choice, and otherwise calls WildBattle.start. A normal start return is ignored; tail clears encounter_type and force_single thenreturnstrue. Double gate respects forcedsingle, Safari exclusion, partner and sufficient able party plus terrainchance. This refines rod/headbutt stats: request completion does not prove victory/capture/battle startup success.
facts.control: only_singletrue skips double predicate. Single/dual missing choice isfalse; normal WildBattle.start false still reachestrue tail.
facts.failure_prefix: Nil choice or callback/start exception leaves encounter_type and possibly force_single uncleared because noensure; earlier event modifications may survive. Only normal tail clears both. Rod stats may already increment before this request; Headbutt stat increments aftertruthy completion in its separately read caller.
